name: aiFunctions
description: Call Databricks AI Functions for classification, extraction, and structured decisions

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for one upstream request

retry.description: Retry for unavailable (503) responses, and any rate-limit (429) response that reaches the plugin. The Databricks SDK retries 429 internally until `timeout` cancels it, so a sustained rate limit surfaces as 504. Other errors are never retried.

tasks.description: Named tasks: AI Functions requests minus their input. Each is reachable at POST /api/ai-functions/:task/invoke, with useAiFunction, and as the agent tool <task>.invoke.

must: Define tasks in a shared file, such as shared/ai-tasks.ts, and pass aiFunctions({ tasks }) in the server file
Call tasks from the client with useAiFunction from @databricks/appkit-ui/react/beta
should: Use auth: "on-behalf-of-user" only when calls should be attributed to the signed-in user
